name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering and speed. Growing up near Suzuka Circuit, he spent countless weekends watching races, dreaming of contributing to the sport. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Kyoto University, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. After graduating, Kenji joined a small engineering firm specializing in race car development, where he honed his technical skills and gained invaluable experience in data analysis and performance optimization. 

His methodical approach and sharp eye for detail quickly led to a leadership role, managing small teams on various projects. Kenji's transition to Garage 59 as Head of Operations was driven by his ambition to contribute to a larger, more competitive organization. He believes in fostering a data-driven environment, pushing his team to constantly analyze and improve every aspect of the team's performance. Kenji is known for his unwavering focus on perfection and his ability to identify and solve complex problems under pressure. 

He is a firm believer in continuous improvement and isn't afraid to challenge the status quo, making him a vital asset to Garage 59. His technical background combined with his management skills allows him to bridge the gap between the engineering team and the operational side of the racing organization.
